title: Sanctuary Golf Classic:
headline: Guests give the Navy SEAL Foundation one word each, then the video reveals the question and follows the day: the anthem, the course, the support, the Toast to the Fallen, and a Gold Star sister's best advice.
story: The day is the Sanctuary Golf Classic, 25 June 2026, Sedalia, Colorado: about 140 guests: donors, sponsors, the host committee and members of the Naval Special Warfare community. Every guest got the same questions on camera. The hook plays five of their one-word answers before we know the question.

Every answer gets its question. The question is revealed at 00:04 and each new question goes on screen when it is asked: the one word, what support the Foundation gives, the best golf tip. Arc: arrival and registration, the National Anthem, the course and Push-ups for Putts, Chris Brown naming the support, the Toast to the Fallen in silence, then Tiffany Bitz, sister of Navy SEAL Danny Dietz, turns a golf tip into her brother's advice: never give up. Warm close.
do: Open on five faces, one word each, with <q>What question are they answering?</q> on screen at 0:00.
Reveal the question at 00:04, and put every question on screen when it is asked.
Give the anthem and the Toast to the Fallen their own sound: no music, no text.
Use B-roll where the words name the day: registration, carts, the green, Push-ups for Putts.
End on Tiffany's face after <q>how amazing you can be</q>, then the end card.
dont: No answer without its question on screen. That was the note on V2.
No one in uniform in any shot. No active-duty face without consent.
No upbeat music or jokes around the Toast to the Fallen.
Do not use Justin's diamonds joke (a sponsor plug) or Chris Brown's lost program name.
Never write Navy SEAL Foundation without <q>the</q>. SEAL always in capitals.
